answer: The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A voyage of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ridge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the zenith is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
